content: Aytmas n Yusuf usin-dd ɣar Miṣra i twařa tamezwarut
Řami iẓra Yaɛqub belli aqa din řḥebb n yirden di Miṣra, xenni inna i iḥenjiren nnes “Maɣar teqqimem txezzarem ijjen deg wenneɣni?”
Inna: “Aqa necc sřiɣ belli din imendi di Miṣra. Ruḥem dinni uca sɣem aneɣ-dd ssenni řḥebb, ḥima ad neqqim neddar uca war nettmetti ca.”
Hwan ɛecra n wawmaten n Yusuf, maḥend ad raḥen ad sɣen imendi zi Miṣra.
Maca Yaɛqub war issekk Binyamin, umas n Yusuf, ak-d aytmas, minzi inna: “Ḥima war d as ittemsar ca n řḥajjet d taɛeffant.”
Jar inni dd-yusin dinni, usin-dd ɛawed ayt n Israil, maḥend ad sɣen macca, minzi tuɣa din řaẓ di temmurt n Kenɛan.
Tuɣa Yusuf d řḥakem x temmurt uca izzenz imendi i marra řgens n temmurt. Umi dd-iwḍen aytmas n Yusuf, bendqen as s uɣembub nsen ɣar temmurt.
Umi iẓra Yusuf aytmas, iɛqeř i-ten, maca igga ixef nnes axmi war ten issin uca issiweř akidsen s řeqsaḥet, inna asen: “Manis dd-tusim?” Nnan: “Zi temmurt n Kenɛan, maḥend ad nseɣ macca.”
Yusuf iɛeqř aytmas, maca nitni war t ɛqiřen ca.
Ifekkar Yusuf di tirja nni tuɣa xasen yurja, inna asen: “Kenniw d ibergagen i teǧam, tusim-dd, ḥima ad tẓarem mani war tᵉttwaḥḍi temmurt.”
Arrin-dd xas: “Lla, a sidi inu, ɛad imsexxaren nnec usin-dd, maḥend ad sɣen macca.
Marra neccin aqa aneɣ d tarwa n ijj n weryaz. Aqa aneɣ d iryazen d imtiqqan, imsexxaren nnec war ǧin ca d ibergagen.”
Netta yarra-dd xasen: “Lla, kenniw tusim-dd maḥend ad tẓarem tuɛɛaryent n temmurt.”
Nnan nitni: “Neccin d imsexxaren nnec, aqa aneɣ di tenɛac n wawmaten, tarwa n ijj n weryaz di temmurt n Kenɛan. Aqa amaẓuẓ aqa-t ak-d babatneɣ u wenneɣni war iǧi ɛad.”
Inna asen Yusuf: “Ma war d awem t nniɣ umi nniɣ: ‘Aqa kenniw d ibergagen!’
S uya tᵉttwaqeǧbem. S tidett am iddar firɛun, kenniw war dd-tteffɣem ssa, mɣir xmi dd ɣa yas umatwem amaẓuẓ danita!
Sekkem ijj n zzaywem, maḥend ad dd-yawi umatwem. Xenni kenniw ad tᵉttwaḥebbsem uca awařen nwem ad ttwaqeǧben, ma daywem řaman. Mařa lla, s tidett am iddar firɛun, aqa kenniw d ibergagen!”
Uca igga i-ten třata n wussan di řeḥbes.
Deg wass wiss třata inna asen Yusuf: “Ggem aya, ḥima ad teqqimem teddarem, necc tteggʷdeɣ AREBBI.
Mařa kenniw d iryazen d imtiqqan, jjem xenni ijj n umatwem ad iqqim icarf di taddart mani tᵉttwaḥebbsem kenniw, xenni ruḥem, ksim imendi i řaẓ n aytbab n taddart nwem.
Awyem-dd xenni umatwem, amaẓuẓ, maḥend ad ttwaqeǧben wawařen nwem, war tᵉttmettim ca.” Uca nitni ggin amenni.
Nnan i wayawya: “S tidett aqa ittxeṣṣa aneɣ ad dd-narr ddeyyet n umatneɣ, aqa neẓra řḥeṣran n řeɛmar nnes umi d aneɣ ittar aḥinni, maca war d as nesři ca! X uya dd-yusa řḥeṣran-a xaneɣ.”
Yarra-dd xasen Rubin, inna: “Ma war d awem t nniɣ, umi nniɣ: ‘War xeṭṭim ca ak-d uḥenjir!’, maca kenniw war tesřim ca. Xzar, idammen nnes ttwattaren řexxu!”
Nitni war ssinen belli ifhem asen Yusuf, minzi tuɣa aturjman jar asen.
Inneqřeb xasen uca isɣuy. Awarni as inneqřeb-dd ɛawed ɣarsen, issiweř akidsen, iksi zzaysen Cimɛun uca iḥebbes i-t zzat i tiṭṭawin nsen.
Yumur Yusuf maḥend ad ccuren tixuncay nsen s imendi u ad ggen tmenyat n nnuqart di kuř ict n txancet nsen uca wcin asen macca i webrid. U ammu i kidsen ggin.
Ssarbun imendi nsen x yeɣyař nsen uca ffɣen ssenni.
Umi yarzem ijjen zzaysen taxancet nnes, ḥima ad issecc aɣyuř nnes ɣar mani ɣa ssensen, iẓra nnuqart nnes deg arzam n uqemmum n txancet nnes.
Inna i yaytmas: “Nnuqart inu tedweř ayi-dd. Xzar, aqa-tt da di txancet inu!” Řexdenni ibedd asen wuř, arjijen uca nnan i wayawya: “Manawya i d aneɣ ittegg AREBBI?”
Uca reḥḥgen ɣar babatsen Yaɛqub di temmurt n Kenɛan uca ɛawden as marra min xasen ikkin, nnan:
“Aryaz, bab n temmurt, issiweř akidneɣ s řeqsaḥet, iḥesb aneɣ d ibergagen n temmurt.
Maca nenna as: ‘Neccin d iryazen d imtiqqan, ɛemmarṣ war neǧi d ibergagen.
Aqa aneɣ di tenɛac n wawmaten, iḥenjiren n babatneɣ. Ijjen war iqqim, amaẓuẓ aqa-t ass-a ak-d babatneɣ di temmurt n Kenɛan.’
U aryaz nni, bab n temmurt, inna aneɣ: ‘S uya ad ssneɣ, ma aqa kenniw d imtiqqan. Ad kidi tejjem ijjen zeg aytmatwem uca ad teksim macca i řaẓ nni din ɣar aytbab n taddart nwem, xenni ffɣem.
Awyem-dd da umatwem, amaẓuẓ, xenni ad ssneɣ belli war teǧim d ibergagen, maca d imtiqqan uca ad awem dd-arxuɣ i wamatwem nwem uca ad traḥem ad tjuřem di temmurt.’”
Umi ssexwan tixuncay nsen, ḥekkaren belli di txancet n kuř ijjen, aqa dayes tacyart s nnuqart nnes. Ẓrin nitni d babatsen ticyar s nnuqart nsen uca tudef i-ten tiggʷudi.
Inna asen babatsen Yaɛqub: “Aqa tḥarrmem ayi zeg iḥenjiren inu! Yusuf war dd-iḍhar ɛad uřa d Cimɛun, uca řexxu tᵉttexsem ad tnedhem Binyamin. Marra man aya ittemsaren di řeɛkes inu!”
Xenni issiweř Rubin ɣar babas, inna: “Ad tenɣed tnayen n iḥenjiren inu, mařa war d ac t-i-dd-arriɣ. Ewc ayi t deg ufus inu, necc aqa ad ac t-i-dd-arreɣ!”
Maca netta inna as: “Mmi war ittriḥ ca akidwem, minzi umas immut u netta weḥḥdes i d ayi iqqimen. Mařa iřqef i-t ca n řɣar deg webrid nni i ɣa tekkem, ad tessehwam ccib inu s wecḍan ɣar řaxart.”
